meta_title: NYCU LIFE | Your campus digital companion
meta_description: NYCU LIFE is a campus digital companion that brings campus buses, course discovery, and campus activities into one place, turning the everyday parts of campus life into a single set of tools.
hero_lede: Buses that run late, school information you can't find, course rules that make no sense? NYCU LIFE brings the everyday parts of campus life together into one set of tools.
hero_image_caption: Campus Bus · live vehicle positions and arrival times
app_hero_lede: A group of NYCU students, polishing the small frictions of campus life into fluid, luminous digital tools.
menu_products_desc: Campus buses, course discovery, event sign-ups — every small tool we make.
menu_about_desc: How we started, the people behind it, and how to join.
menu_courses_desc: Workshops and study sessions — learning by getting our hands dirty.
menu_devlog_desc: A log of us solving the small frictions of campus life, one at a time.
coming_soon_body: This section is in the works — it'll show up here once the content is ready.
why_lede: We have all lived on this campus and know exactly where things get stuck. NYCU LIFE sets out to untangle those everyday problems, honestly, one at a time.
why_bus_pain: Campus and city buses run late, with routes and schedules that keep changing, so waiting comes down to luck.
why_bus_answer: Campus Bus shows live vehicle positions and arrival ETAs, bringing campus and city buses together so you know when the next one arrives.
why_info_pain: School announcements and key information are scattered everywhere; drop deadlines and how to reach a professor take ages to find.
why_info_answer: We gather the tools and information students use most into one entry point, making it clearer what the next step is.
why_course_pain: Course selection and general-education or credit rules are confusing, and the same class can count for different credits depending on the path.
why_course_answer: NYCozU lays out 3,760+ courses with credits and time slots clearly, with search and filters in one place, so you stop guessing.
why_commute_pain: Commuting between the Yangming and Chiaotung campuses, transfers and timing are always hard to pin down.
why_commute_answer: Campus Bus presents cross-campus shuttles and buses together, so moving between campuses reads like one complete trip.
products_lede: Each product solves one concrete campus task, and they all share the same clear, easy-to-use design language.
product_bus_summary: Campus and city buses in one readable flow, so waiting for a ride is no longer a gamble.
product_bus_feature_1: Live vehicle positions, routes, and stops
product_bus_feature_3: Campus and city buses brought together
product_coz_summary: Search 3,760+ courses at once, with credits and time slots at a glance, so course selection stops being a guessing game.
product_coz_feature_1: Search 3,760+ courses and look up rooms
product_coz_feature_2: Advanced filters to narrow down fast
product_coz_feature_3: Credits and time slots at a glance
product_activity_summary: Browse, register for, and administer campus activities in one flow, from sign-up to check-in.
product_activity_feature_1: Browse campus activities and register online
product_map_summary: A digital campus map that makes the next place to go clearer. In development, stay tuned.
product_map_feature_3: Linked to course and activity locations
course_lede: Course selection is the biggest headache each semester. NYCozU lays out all 3,760+ courses clearly, so search and filters help you find the right classes fast.
course_point_1_body: Search by course name, code, or instructor, then use advanced filters to narrow down to the classes you actually want.
course_point_2_title: Credits and time slots at a glance
course_point_2_body: Every course shows its credits, time slot, and room clearly, so building a schedule no longer feels frantic.
course_point_3_body: Want to know when a room is free? Just look it up and save yourself from asking around.
devlog_lede: NYCU LIFE keeps iterating. Here are some recent milestones, an honest look at where each product stands.
devlog_1_title: Campus Bus · arrival ETAs go live
devlog_1_body: Campus Bus launches live arrival times (ETA), integrating campus and city bus information.
devlog_2_body: The course discovery platform finishes indexing every course, with advanced filters and room lookup.
devlog_3_body: Online registration, QR tickets, and the admin review console for campus activities are in development, launching soon.
devlog_4_body: A digital campus map is being planned, to be linked with course and activity locations.
team_title: Built by students, made for students
team_lede: NYCU LIFE is a project run in their spare time by students who believe campus life can be better. The team is organized by department, and the roster keeps growing as new members join.
team_more_body: This roster is still growing. If you would like to build with us, you are welcome to join.
